description:
Private push-to-talk dictation that runs entirely on your machine.

Koegaki is push-to-talk dictation for Windows. Hold a key, speak, and your words appear wherever you are typing. The speech model runs entirely on-device, so audio and text never leave your machine. No account, no cloud, no subscription. 30-day free trial, then a one-time purchase covers Mac and Windows.
- From this version on, after Koegaki restarts itself for a model update or to recover the microphone, an app update installed later opens the new version instead of leaving it waiting unseen in the background.
- When Koegaki restarts itself, for a model update or to recover the microphone, it now gives changes made in Settings time to save first. If a change cannot be saved when you choose Restart now for a model update, Koegaki says so and does not restart.
- If Koegaki restarts itself for a model update or to recover the microphone and the new copy cannot launch, the one you were using now keeps running instead of closing.
